shared_elements: standing human figure in elaborate costume
figure holding an object in the hands
relief carving on a flat upright panel
glyph-like inscribed signs within the field
justification: Both depict elaborately costumed standing human figures in relief with headdresses, bracelets and necklaces, holding objects, accompanied by inscribed sign-like elements. But A is a single frontal figure standing on a crouching captive, engulfed in dense curvilinear ornament that nearly dissolves the body, while B shows two bearded figures in strict profile facing each other across a raised offering, drawn in clean linear outline with orderly patterned drapery and a horizontal text band — different figure counts, orientation, and wholly different ornamental conventions.
